Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Finance Officer role. For the last five years I have prepared monthly financial reporting under IFRS, owned bank reconciliations across six accounts and supported external audits.

At Zambezi Agro I built the budgeting model in Excel used to control a K40m annual budget, and at Kafue Water Trust I handled grant management and donor reporting, including statutory returns to ZRA.

I would welcome the chance to bring this experience in reconciliations, budgeting and grant controls to your Lusaka operations team.
